_comment: Blocks a player places to light a room, whether or not they are currently emitting light - an unlit redstone lamp on a lever still counts, the same way an unlit candle already does (BlockSignature is keyed on the block, not the block state). "replace": false so packs and other mods can extend this. Deliberately excludes minecraft:magma_block (soulhome:hearth's own heat signal), minecraft:crying_obsidian (soulhome:arcane) and minecraft:lava_cauldron (soulhome:alchemy_vessels, which soulhome:alchemy_lab scores alongside this tag) so no block scores twice in the same room - see issue #45.
